Dream 2026-11-22 linked 4 vignettes from 2 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- 2026-11-03 · retells · "It keeps the human in charge of their own meaning, and provides a way for the AI to support." (The essay editor is a technical implementation of the muDemocracy mindset shift; one URL that gets someone started (2026-11-03))
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "manage writing with their own words vs getting feedback on those words" (The editor's domain is not the application's: its audience holds onto their own words; get it written or develop the ideas, own words or feedback, support or challenge (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "We just limit it's ability to create the mainparagraph text." (Answering the challenger: agents add to the repo, the website is surface meaning, the middle path with AI, the container holds the rough work (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "human and Ai creativity are different. Ai makes the depth of my writing better." (AI's creativity as a peer: it deepens the writing, but it doesn't write the final words (2026-11-06))
